digo_source: Pakia (2005) App. III (Mtandarusi); Maundu & Tengnäs 2005 (Msandarusi, Munyama)
english: Gum copal tree, East African copal

teaser.en: Its gum once lights homes at night and keeps pests out of the maize store.
teaser.sw: Sandarusi yake huwasha mwanga majumbani usiku na kuzuia wadudu ghalani mwa mahindi.
teaser.dg: Kare gamuye yatsomwa kuphaha mwanga nyumbani usiku, na kuzuwiya adudu asiinjire vitsaga vya pemba.

summary.en: *Mtandarusi*, the gum copal tree, is an evergreen tree of the coastal forests of Kwale and Kilifi with beautifully patterned bark. It produces gum copal, *sandarusi*, prized for varnish and glue and burned for light and to protect stored maize.
summary.sw: *Mtandarusi*, au *msandarusi*, ni mti wa kijani mwaka mzima wa misitu ya pwani ya Kwale na Kilifi wenye gome lenye madoa ya kupendeza. Hutoa utomvu mgumu, *sandarusi*, unaothaminiwa kwa varnishi na gundi, na huchomwa kutoa mwanga na kulinda mahindi yaliyohifadhiwa.
summary.dg: *Mtandarusi* (kpwa Chingereza *gum copal tree*) ni muhi wenye makodza chila wakati wa matsaka ga pwani ga Kwale na Kilifi, wenye gopha renye vibara vya rangi tafwauti. Unalavya gamu inayoihwa *sandarusi*, inayomendzwa sana kpwa *varnish* na gundi, na nkutsomwa kuphaha mwanga na kurinda pemba ziikpwazo akiba.

about.en: *Mtandarusi* is an evergreen tree from 6 to 25 metres tall. Its bark is smooth and pale grey, patterned with patches of green, pink and cream. Each leaf is just one pair of glossy leaflets, asymmetric in shape. The pods are warty.
about.sw: *Mtandarusi* ni mti wa kijani mwaka mzima wenye urefu wa mita 6 hadi 25. Gome lake ni laini na la kijivu hafifu, lenye mabaka ya kijani, waridi na rangi ya krimu. Kila jani lina jozi moja tu ya vijani vinavyong'aa, visivyolingana pande mbili. Maganda yake yana vivimbe.
about.dg: *Mtandarusi* ni muhi wenye makodza chila wakati wa mita sita hadi ishirini na tsano kpwa ure. Gophare ni laini na ra rangi ya ivu ngushu-ngushu, renye vibara vya chijani, pinki na rangi ya maziya. Chila kodza ni makodza madide mairi tu ganayong'ala, na kanda mbiri za chila kodza dide si sawa-sawa. Makakaya gana vinundu-nundu.

where.en: It grows in coastal forest, woodland and evergreen bushland in Kwale and Kilifi.
where.sw: Huota katika misitu ya pwani, mapori na vichaka vya kijani mwaka mzima huko Kwale na Kilifi.
where.dg: Unamera kpwenye matsaka ga pwani, herera zenye mihi na vitsaka vyenye makodza chila wakati vya Kwale na Kilifi.

uses.en:
The tree's great product is gum copal, *sandarusi*, collected from the bark and from fallen fruit. It is prized for varnish and glue. The gum is burned to light homes at night, and its smoke keeps storage pests out of maize granaries.

The tree also gives hard timber and canoes, and its fruit is edible.
uses.sw:
Zao kuu la mti huu ni utomvu mgumu, *sandarusi*, unaokusanywa kutoka kwenye gome na kutoka kwenye matunda yaliyoanguka. Unathaminiwa kwa varnishi na gundi. Sandarusi huchomwa kuangaza nyumba usiku, na moshi wake huzuia wadudu waharibifu kwenye maghala ya mahindi.

Mti huu pia hutoa mbao ngumu na mitumbwi, na tunda lake huliwa.
uses.dg:
Chitu chikulu cha muhi uhu ni gamu, *sandarusi*, inayohalwa kula kpwa gopha na kula kpwa matunda garigogbwa photsi. Inamendzwa sana kpwa *varnish* na gundi. Gamu nkutsomwa kuphaha mwanga nyumbani usiku, na mosi wa gamu hino nkuzuwiya adudu anaobananga pemba asiinjire vitsaga.

Muhi piya unalavya mbao ngumu na ngarawa, na matundage ganariwa.

culture.en: Pakia records that its seeds are called *tembe za mtandarusi*.
culture.sw: Pakia inarekodi kuwa mbegu zake huitwa *tembe za mtandarusi*.
culture.dg: Pakia anaandika kukala tembeze zinaihwa *tembe za mtandarusi*.

names.en: Pakia records the Digo name *mtandarusi*; the ICRAF handbook gives *msandarusi* and *munyama*. In Swahili it is *mtandarusi* or *msandarusi*, and the gum is *sandarusi*. Giriama names are *mdzongolo* and *msange*. In English it is the gum copal tree or East African copal.
names.sw: Pakia inarekodi jina la Kidigo *mtandarusi*; kitabu cha ICRAF kinatoa *msandarusi* na *munyama*. Kwa Kiswahili unaitwa *mtandarusi* au *msandarusi*, na utomvu wake ni *sandarusi*. Majina ya Kigiriama ni *mdzongolo* na *msange*. Kwa Kiingereza unaitwa *gum copal tree* au *East African copal*.
names.dg: Pakia anaandika dzina ra Chidigo *mtandarusi*; chitabu cha ICRAF chinapha *msandarusi* na *munyama*. Kpwa Chiswahili ni *mtandarusi* au *msandarusi*, na gamu ni *sandarusi*. Madzina ga Chigiryama ni *mdzongolo* na *msange*. Kpwa Chingereza unaihwa *gum copal tree* au *East African copal*.

reason.sw: Mti mwingine wa mbao za thamani wa jamii ya kunde
reason.dg: Muhi wanjina wa jamii ya kunde wenye mbao za samani

reason.sw: Manemane ya Kiafrika, mti mwingine wa utomvu

reason.en: Its seeds are also called tembe

reason.sw: Wanashiriki mapori yale yale ya pwani
reason.dg: Unamera phamwenga nao kpwenye herera za pwani zenye mihi

definition.en: The seeds of the copal tree. They have no use, so they are called 'seeds of …'; the useful timber goes by the tree's own name.
definition.sw: Mbegu za mtandarusi. Hazina matumizi, kwa hiyo huitwa 'mbegu za …'; mbao zenye manufaa hujulikana kwa jina la mti wenyewe.
definition.dg: Tembe za *mtandarusi*. Tazina matumizi, kpwa hivyo zinaihwa 'tembe za …'; mbao za fwaida zinaihwa kpwa dzina ra muhi wenye.
